# Subnational official-stream research

Research date: 2026-10-22. Jurisdictions searched: **1121 / 1121 currently inventoried**. The global inventory is **still expanding**.

Broad discovery across the 71 maintained Tier 1/Tier 2 country audit groups, including regional bodies and special-status territories. The public catalogue is restricted by legislative authority; discovery rows are not counts of eligible parliaments.

Establish jurisdiction inventory from official directories, then run a jurisdiction-specific official-source video and committee search. Record source-page access separately from active-media, event/room identity and rights validation. Never treat a pending inventory row as researched.

A search result is a lead, not a verified live stream. A successful page fetch is not a playback, room-identity, rights or schedule validation. Country scope dispositions distinguish no core regional legislature established from unresolved inventories. Discovery counts are not eligible-parliament counts; apply docs/catalogue-scope.md.

Country groupings for related territories are research associations, not sovereignty assertions. Read each constitutional relationship and scope note. The remaining-country source-check files record primary-source access attempts; they do not certify complete country inventories.

An inventoried body is not automatically a primary law-making parliament. First-level regional deliberative councils are labelled separately; ordinary municipalities are outside this pass unless they also perform the first-level role. Special-status and related territories require explicit relationships.

Body class: `regional_legislative_assembly`. Relationship: `first_level`.

Catalogue eligibility: **eligible_legislature**. The councils have autonomous provincial ordinance-making powers, initiative and amendment rights, budget authority and executive accountability/inquiry powers. Articles 124 and 127 establish provincial internal-affairs regulation and council enactment of ordinances, alongside municipal provisions; this is not a current consolidated statute check.

- [Resolved legislative-authority evidence](https://www.limburg.nl/onderwerpen/omgeving/omgevingsverordening-limburg/) — Opened current province explanation.. Explains instruction rules for lower authorities and rules directly binding residents/businesses. September 2026 amendment adoption is distinguished from later publication/commencement.
